title: Introduce cost floorplanner service and compact quantizer proxy for tenant defaults
author: Marisol Chen
description: Introduce a Cost Floorplanner microservice plus a Compact Quantizer Proxy to automate tenant-level budget-aware defaults for batching, caching, and quantization. The Floorplanner synthesizes per-tenant budget floors and safe default overrides from historical unit-econ traces and traffic shapes; the Quantizer Proxy exposes graded quant suggestion badges (fp16, int8, awq-lite) with safety fallback rules tied to latency SLOs. This change wires synthesized defaults into the defaults compiler, adds a CLI dry-run simulation mode, and provides a small smoke harness for perf regression detection. Motivation: avoid surprise cost spikes by proactively suggesting conservative, audited defaults while maintaining predictable latency and graceful degradation. This is feature-flagged behind cost_floorplanner_v1 and is opt-in; no tenant defaults change without opt-in. Linear refs: ENG-3381, ENG-3492. Checklist: [x] implementation; [x] CLI dry-run; [x] unit tests; [x] integration smoke; [x] docs; [ ] telemetry label polish.
